calculation.description: For each tradable asset, estimate a rolling 60-day beta to SPX, subtract beta times SPX daily return from the asset return, sum residual returns over 20 completed days, and divide by 20-day residual volatility. The one-day lag prevents look-ahead. Higher values indicate persistent idiosyncratic trend independent of broad equity beta.
calculation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; minimum 8 valid names per date

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2020-22 (IC 0.005933, ICIR 0.019934), negative in 2023-25 (IC -0.006446, ICIR -0.021355), positive in 2026-27 (IC 0.011410, ICIR 0.036531), and sharply negative in 2028 YTD (IC -0.068090, ICIR -0.203348). Full-sample admission gates pass, but regime drift and high turnover require conservative use and revalidation.
